newsHighlights.title: New products and technologies take spotlight at Canton Fair
newsHighlights.summary: The 140th edition of the China Import and Export Fair kicked off in Guangzhou, focusing on new, green and smart products.
newsHighlights.translation: 第140届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）在广州开幕，重点展示新型、绿色、智能产品。

newsHighlights.title: Premier Li calls for open world economy as Canton Fair marks 70 years
newsHighlights.summary: Premier Li called for an open world economy as the Canton Fair celebrated its 70th anniversary.
newsHighlights.translation: 在广交会迎来70周年之际，李总理呼吁建设开放型世界经济。

newsHighlights.title: Xi: Ensure stable supply chains
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi stressed the need to ensure stable and resilient global supply chains.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席强调要确保全球供应链稳定且富有韧性。

newsHighlights.title: Hot US inflation, rising AI costs spark global chip stock rout
newsHighlights.summary: Hot US inflation and rising AI costs triggered a global sell-off in chip stocks.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国通胀高企与人工智能成本上升引发全球芯片股暴跌。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题是，人们误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 职场中，很多误解源于"以为已经说清楚了"。真正的沟通需要确认对方是否接收并理解了信息，而非单向地传达。

vocabulary.example: New products and technologies took center stage at the Canton Fair, highlighting China's drive for innovation.
vocabulary.translation: 新产品与新技术在广交会上大放异彩，彰显了中国对创新的追求。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻标题 "New products and technologies take spotlight at Canton Fair"。

vocabulary.example: The 140th edition of the exhibition attracted buyers and delegates from around the world.
vocabulary.translation: 第140届展会吸引了来自世界各地的采购商和代表。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自关于 Canton Fair（广交会，即中国进出口商品交易会）的报道。

vocabulary.example: At the fair, buyers and sellers negotiate prices, delivery dates and contract terms face to face.
vocabulary.translation: 在展会上，买卖双方面对面协商价格、交货日期与合同条款。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与广交会贸易洽谈场景相关，是职场商务沟通核心词汇。

vocabulary.example: Xi called on all parties to ensure stable and smooth supply chains.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平呼吁各方确保供应链稳定畅通。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻 "Xi: Ensure stable supply chains"。

vocabulary.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
vocabulary.example: Companies must build resilient supply chains to survive sudden market shocks.
vocabulary.translation: 企业必须打造有韧性的供应链，以应对突如其来的市场冲击。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与 "Ensure stable supply chains" 新闻中强调的供应链韧性相关。

vocabulary.example: Green and sustainable products were the highlight of this year's Canton Fair.
vocabulary.translation: 绿色可持续产品是本届广交会的一大亮点。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻中 "Focusing on new, green, and smart products" 的描述。

vocabulary.example: Hot US inflation and rising AI costs sparked a global chip stock rout.
vocabulary.translation: 美国通胀高企与人工智能成本上升引发了全球芯片股暴跌。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻 "Hot US inflation, rising AI costs spark global chip stock rout"。

vocabulary.example: Premier Li said international collaboration is essential for an open world economy.
vocabulary.translation: 李总理表示，国际合作对建设开放型世界经济至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻 "Premier Li calls for open world economy as Canton Fair marks 70 years"。

vocabulary.example: Delegates from more than 200 countries and regions attended the trade fair in Guangzhou.
vocabulary.translation: 来自200多个国家和地区的代表参加了广州的这场贸易盛会。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与广交会中外客商、代表参会的场景相关。

vocabulary.example: The 70th anniversary of the Canton Fair marks an important milestone in China's trade history.
vocabulary.translation: 广交会70周年是中国贸易史上的一个重要里程碑。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻 "as Canton Fair marks 70 years"。

pattern.pattern: call for + 名词/动名词（呼吁……）
pattern.example: Premier Li calls for an open world economy as the Canton Fair marks 70 years.
pattern.translation: 在广交会迎来70周年之际，李总理呼吁建设开放型世界经济。
pattern.usage: 用于正式场合表达诉求、提议或呼吁。常见搭配：call for action（呼吁采取行动）、call for reform（呼吁改革）。名词形式为 a call for...，如 a call for closer cooperation（加强合作的呼吁）。

grammar.title: as 引导时间/原因状语从句
grammar.explanation: as 可引导时间状语从句，表示"当……时/随着……"，强调两个动作同时发生或一种伴随变化；也可表示原因，意为"由于"。在新闻英语中常用于简洁地交代背景。判断依据：时间含义时可替换为 when/while；原因含义时可替换为 because/since。
examples: Premier Li calls for an open world economy as the Canton Fair marks 70 years.
Chip stocks fell sharply as US inflation stayed hot and AI costs continued to rise.

pronunciation.tips: 五个音节，重音在倒数第三个音节 la 上（/ˌlæbəˈreɪʃən/ 中主重音为 /ˈreɪ/ 前的 /ˈlæ/？注意：主重音在 -ra- 上：/kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃən/）。实际发音要点：首音节弱读为 /kə/，不要读成 /kəʊ/；/læb/ 中的 a 为梅花音 /æ/，口型扁平；-tion 统一读 /ʃən/。整词节奏为"弱-弱-强-弱"式，练习时先读准 colla-BOR-a-tion 的重音落点。
examples: International collaboration is essential for an open world economy.
The project requires close collaboration between engineers and sales teams.

reading.title: Canton Fair Turns 70: A Global Stage for Business and Communication
reading.content: The 140th China Import and Export Fair, better known as the Canton Fair, opened in Guangzhou on Thursday. This year's event marks the fair's 70th anniversary and focuses on new, green and smart products. Premier Li called for an open world economy, saying international collaboration is essential for shared growth. Buyers and delegates from over 200 countries and regions attended the exhibition to negotiate contracts and build long-term partnerships. Meanwhile, business leaders stressed the need to ensure stable and resilient supply chains. Beyond the fair, global markets remained nervous: hot US inflation and rising AI costs sparked a sharp sell-off in chip stocks. For professionals, the news offers a useful lesson — clear communication, careful negotiation and reliable supply chains are the foundations of successful business.
reading.translation: 第140届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）于周四在广州开幕。本届展会迎来广交会70周年，聚焦新型、绿色与智能产品。李总理呼吁建设开放型世界经济，表示国际合作对共同增长至关重要。来自200多个国家和地区的采购商与代表参加了展会，洽谈合同并建立长期伙伴关系。与此同时，商界领袖强调确保供应链稳定与韧性的重要性。在展会之外，全球市场依然紧张：美国通胀高企与人工智能成本上升引发芯片股大幅抛售。对职场人士而言，这些新闻带来一个有益的启示——清晰的沟通、审慎的谈判和可靠的供应链，是商业成功的基石。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 China Daily《New products and technologies take spotlight at Canton Fair》《Xi: Ensure stable supply chains》及 CGTN《Premier Li calls for open world economy as Canton Fair marks 70 years》《Hot US inflation, rising AI costs spark global chip stock rout》改写。
